jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. safety strategies for compounds in development and marketed products.Working within a global, cross-functional environment, you will play a key role in enabling informed development decisions and bringing meaningful therapeutic innovations to patients worldwide.Join us in shaping the future of medicine - apply now!This position can be filled in Ingelheim or BiberachThis position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site.Tasks & responsibilities- As part of your role, you will design and implement proactive, patient-centric risk management strategies for assigned evaluating and enhancing the benefit-risk profile of your products by integrating clinical data and patient insights.- You will engage in close collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to address safety concerns and implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies.- Your medical-scientific expertise will be essential in preparing regulatory documents such as DSURs, and trial related documents such as investigator's brochure, clinical trial protocols, clinical reports ensuring accuracy and compliance.- In your senior capacity, you will chair the multidisciplinary Asset Benefit-Risk Team and represent Experimental Medicine Patient Safety in strategic committees and regulatory interactions.Requirements- Medical Doctor with long-standing clinical or research experience, experience in CRM (cardio renal metabolic) therapeutic area would be an asset.- Profound experience in pharmacovigilance and Risk Management in a pharmaceutical company on a global / corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety.- Thorough understanding of PV regulation in major markets and respective need for compliance- Experience in clinical development and submissions for marketing authorization would be an asset- Very good and broad understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, and the future trends and developments including pharmacovigilance- Strong ethical sense combined with quality and patient safety mindset- Profund Project Management competencies with good interpersonal and communication skills- Excellent English skills, both written and spokenAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. jobs.description: You have a passion for technology and want to help shape the future of energy?Then become a playmaker and join our team at E.ON Digital Technology.​We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. Your Role – meaningful und rewarding- Develop and continuously improve E.ON’s Group-wide crisis management framework, standards and processes together with Crisis Management leads and experts across the business units - Initiate and jointly drive Group-wide Crisis Management topics, fostering collaboration, alignment and knowledge sharing across E.ON’s German and European businesses - Lead crisis preparedness activities, including crisis plans, playbooks, exercises, training and lessons-learned processes  - Coordinate and support E.ON’s crisis management organization during major incidents, including activation, situation reporting and escalation processes - Provide structured decision support to E.ON’s crisis management team and senior management through situation assessments, scenario analysis, options and recommendations during crises- Continuously monitor and assess relevant threats and emerging risks and translate them into actionable situation reports, executive briefings and recommendations - Monitor relevant regulatory requirements, industry developments and best practices and translate them into practical improvements to E.ON’s crisis management capabilities- Coordinate and maintain key interfaces with authorities, emergency services, industry associations and other external crisis partners - Collaborate closely with Business Continuity, Physical Security, Communications, IT, OT and other key functions to strengthen E.ON’s crisis preparedness and organizational resilience  Your Profile – authentic und open-minded- Extensive professional experience in Crisis Management within a corporate, critical infrastructure or similarly complex operational environment - Proven experience in developing and operating crisis management frameworks and in supporting or managing crisis response  - Strong understanding of crisis management, emergency preparedness, critical infrastructure protection and organisational resilience, including relevant standards such as ISO 22361 and ISO 22301 - Experience working with senior management and external crisis partners such as authorities, emergency services and industry organisations; experience with crisis management tools, alerting systems and structured situation reporting is an advantage - Good understanding of the interdependencies between business operations, physical infrastructure and IT/OT environments, ideally within the energy or critical infrastructure sector - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex situations and translate them into clear recommendations under pressure - Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with proven experience working collaboratively across functions, business units and countries - Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership - Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​- Stay active und healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

Neuronal exocytosis is a highly regulated process that enables the rapid release of neurotransmitters from synaptic vesicles. Central to this process is the controlled assembly of SNARE protein complexes, which drive membrane fusion and are regulated by a network of associated proteins. The PhD project will investigate the structural and molecular mechanisms underlying SNARE complex assembly and function in membrane-like environments. A particular focus will be placed on the development and characterization of membrane-mimetic systems, including lipid nanodiscs and synthetic copolymers, to study SNARE complexes and their regulatory proteins under increasingly native-like conditions. Cryo-electron microscopy will be combined with complementary biochemical and biophysical approaches to characterize these systems at the molecular level.The project offers the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary structural biology environment at Forschungszentrum Jülich, with access to expertise in cryo-EM, NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography. Cryo-EM studies will be conducted at the state-of-the-art facilities of the Ernst Ruska-Centre (ER-C) at Forschungszentrum Jülich. The expertise in NMR spectroscopy and macromolecular crystallography at IBI-7 offers further opportunities for complementary structural and biophysical characterization. This combination of methods will enable the candidate to address biological questions from different structural perspectives and to develop a broad expertise in modern structural biology. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:A Master’s degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, structural biology, or a related fieldStrong practical experience in protein biochemistry, including recombinant protein expression and purificationPrevious hands-on experience with cryo-electron microscopy and/or cryo-EM sample preparationInterest in membrane proteins, protein-protein interactions and structural biologyAbility to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary research teamGood communication skills in English
